title: Drop-In Tech Time with Oliver
description: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Drop by the 2nd floor desk for Tech Time with Oliver every Sunday from 1-3pm. Bring your questions about technology (phones, tablets, laptops, email, etc.) or learn about special collections the library offers, such as the Kindles, iPads, and laptops our patrons can check out as well as the library apps you can download to your devices to access free ebooks, audiobooks, movies, music, magazines and more! Pásate por el 2º piso para Tech Time con Oliver (habla español) todos los domingos de 1 a 3pm. Traiga sus preguntas sobre tecnología (teléfonos, tabletas, computadoras portátiles, correo electrónico, etc.) o conozca las colecciones especiales que ofrece la biblioteca, como los Kindles, iPads y computadoras portátiles que nuestros usuarios pueden rentar, así como las aplicaciones de la biblioteca que puede descargar en sus dispositivos para acceder a libros electrónicos, audiolibros, películas, música, revistas y más.

title: Immersive Sound Journey with Dustin Wells
description: 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM · An immersive sound journey is a live musical experience you take lying down. Musician and sound ceremony artist Dustin Wells surrounds the room with sacred instruments — gongs, shamanic drums, singing bowls, crystal bowls, wind chimes — woven live with synths, guitar, and voice into a single two-hour soundscape. The journey moves through a deliberate arc, from settling in to full sound to a quiet return, designed to guide the nervous system out of fight-or-flight and into the state where the body does its own healing. Come as you are; leave with what you came for. · Please arrive 30 minutes early to find your spot and get comfortable. · Suggested: bring what makes the floor feel like home — a yoga mat, pillow, blanket, or eye mask. Guests lie down if there's room, or sit as needed. …

title: Tea and Tarot
description: 2:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Tea and Tarot Sessions with Jade Rose and others from Sanctuary Collective Seating is limited; please sign up here in advance.   Tea Ceremony is a perfect elemental art. Silently, we drink tea from ancient trees grown in reverence. In this special space we give the water, fire and tea leaves a chance to communicate with us in their subtle and silent tongue. Old growth trees have been taking in sunlight, rainwater and starlight for hundreds of years. Drinking tea from their leaves in a ceremonial space allows us access parts of our heart which we usually cannot reach.

title: Long Table Dinner/Cena De Mesa Larga
description: 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM · Join us for an evening of community, connection, and culinary delight at Wilkinson Public Library's Long Table Dinner on Sunday, November 8th at 6PM. This free gathering invites adults to share a memorable Indian meal catered by Sue and Brady from La Cocina/Pescado. Enjoy an elegant yet relaxed atmosphere where you can meet new friends, engage in lively conversation, and savor Indian dishes crafted with creativity and care. Seating is purposely randomized (you will draw a table color when you arrive) so that you meet and talk to new people! You can arrive with your friends or family, but you won't be sitting with them. For adults only please. Because space is limited, registration is required. …
